about: Real role-result alerts from the Ultimafia game archive (mafia.db on the PC, read-only), sanitized: every player name in a name slot is replaced by a fake name (Ash, Bea, ...); report lines with free-text names (carol, law, mask, love, beer, dowse) were dropped. templateCount is how often that template occurs in the archive. expected: target (fake name) and result as written in the alert, or null when the line is not this seat's own check (system reveals, other roles' alerts, a Boastful Cop overheard publicly, player quotes).
